name: doubtsolve-ai
description: DoubtSolve.ai — Gemini → Lesson JSON → Remotion 2D + Three.js 3D → ElevenLabs → FFmpeg

scripts.ui:build: npm run build --prefix frontend && powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Test-Path web) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force web }; Copy-Item -Recurse frontend\out web"
scripts.generate:sample: py -3 main.py --input "An object is thrown at an angle. Explain projectile motion and calculate its range." --visual-mode HYBRID --quality FAST_PREVIEW --debug

author: DoubtSolve.ai
